column1: # note: The 2025 Tax rate charts, for taxable income of $50,000 or more, below the tax tables. Chart S is for single and married filing separately; Chart J for married filing jointly, head of household and qualifying surviving spouse. Each is repeated for every status it covers.
# note: Each chart's first row reads "$50,000 or more", so it starts at $50,000 itself.
# note: The instructions say not to enter cents and to round to the nearest dollar (page 14).
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
